_note: Fill in `inputs` using the unit in each _guide entry. Help text may quote SI units; the `unit` field is the one that applies. psig and psia are different: gauge arguments (set_g, back_g ...) are psig, absolute ones psia. Temperatures are readings, not differences.

text.help: words that must all appear in designation, title, body, topics or note

body.help: e.g. API, ASTM, NFPA, IEC, ISO, HSE

region.help: e.g. US, UK, EU, IN, NO, global

kind.help: regulation, standard, guidance, book, database, data-tool, investigation, journal, association, course, access-route

activity.help: show one row of the design reading map, e.g. relief-flare or low-temperature; 'list' shows the ids

markdown.help: print the whole library as Markdown (docs/STANDARDS_LIBRARY.md)

map_markdown.help: print the reading map as Markdown (docs/DESIGN_STANDARDS_RECOMMENDATIONS.md)
